context: UserAvatar shows a user's picture with a hover tooltip, falling back to initials on image load error. It renders a placeholder when no user is provided.
explanation: The early return for the null-user case was moved above the useState and useMemo calls. When user toggles between null and a real value across renders, React calls a different number of hooks on each render, violating the Rules of Hooks — this throws "Rendered fewer hooks than expected" or silently corrupts hook state. Fix: keep all hook calls before any conditional return.
